description: An expander for sn-vco that adds another sn waveform, as a harmonic or a variation, to the oscillator it is attached to

params.text: Sets the eccentricity of the generator function, -1 to +1, which is what carries the wave from a sine towards a square, a spike or a sawtooth
Multiplies the eccentricity before it is taken through a hyperbolic tangent, 0 to 5, so it is the fine adjustment on the shape
Rotates the generator function, -90 degrees to +90 degrees
Sets the amplitude of the waveform, 0 at the bottom of its travel and 1 at the top
Shifts the generator function sideways, -1 to +1
Shifts the generator function vertically, -1 to +1
Multiplies the base frequency by a whole number from 1 to 5
Added to the eccentricity knob, 5V covering its whole range, with the total held between -1 and +1

inputs.text: Added to the sensitivity knob, 5V covering its whole range, with the total held between 0 and 5
Added to the rotation knob, 5V covering 90 degrees, with the total held inside 89.95 degrees either way, despite the maker's tooltip naming this jack Φ
Added to the amplitude knob, 5V covering its whole range, with the total held between 0 and 1
Added to the horizontal shift knob, 5V covering its whole range, with the total held between -1 and +1
Added to the vertical shift knob, 5V covering its whole range, with the total held between -1 and +1
Attenuates the summed output, 0 at the bottom of its travel and full level at the top

outputs.text: A 25Hz copy of the waveshape for a scope, at ±5V, carrying this module's own wave, the summed wave of the stack, or both, according to the menu
This module's own waveform alone, ±5V scaled by the velocity coming from the sn-vco, one poly channel per voice
Every waveform in the stack added together and scaled by the attenuator, ±5V times velocity, one poly channel per voice

notes: Place it directly against the left or right edge of an sn-vco, or of another sn-vcox in the chain; the lamps in the top corners show which side it draws from and which it feeds
It takes its pitch, its voices and its velocity from the sn-vco at the head of the chain, which is why it has no pitch jack of its own
Each of the six jacks down the left is added to the knob beside it, 5V covering that knob's whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's own limits
The summed output adds every waveform in the stack together, so it readily passes ±5V; the attenuator brings it back into range
menu: k-rate — sets how often the knobs and CV are read to rebuild the waveshape: every sample, or once every 64, 128 or 256 samples
aux-mode: OSC, SUM, POLY — chooses whether AUX carries this module's own monitor wave, the summed wave of the whole stack, or the first on channel 1 and the second on channel 2
aux-gain: 1, ½, ⅓, ¼, ⅕ — scales the summed monitor wave down so a tall stack fits on a scope

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±1V.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.
inputs.3:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
inputs.4:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±1V.
inputs.5:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±1V.
